facts.text: Serve dessert when Axel bluffs his way into the swanky mansion party.
facts.why: Axel and the others trace the getaway vehicle to the Playboy Mansion event. The Wikiquote scene shows him pulling a cement truck up to the valet and tipping $50 to park it, not bluffing his way in.
facts.fix: Serve dessert when Axel parks a cement truck at the Playboy Mansion party.

vibe.verdict: The case-file look and the Detroit jacket poster work, but the menu is Eddie Murphy with the jokes taken out.
